description: Use this to see the characters the user can cast in images and videos: the free BudgetPixel AI influencers (memorable personas with a consistent face, like @barry, @rosa or @fifi, free for every user) plus the user's own and collected characters. To cast one, write its @handle in the prompt of generate_image or generate_video (e.g. "@barry orders coffee like he owns the cafe") on a model that takes characters. q filters by words (e.g. "fitness"); source narrows to official, mine or collected. For one character's full profile and pictures call get_character; to pick influencers for a brief call recommend_influencers. Free.

q.description: Optional words that must all appear in the character's name, look or profile, e.g. "fitness" or "beauty".

source.description: Optional: official (the BudgetPixel AI influencers), mine (the user's own), collected, or all (default).

name: list_characters
title: List Characters
